item.title: About Me
item.description: I am Jodavid Ferreira, Professor in the Department of Statistics (DEst) at the Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE), Brazil. Academic Background Postdoctoral Fellowship in Decision Models and Health (PPGMDS) — Federal University of Paraíba (UFPB) Ph.D. in Statistics — Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE) M.Sc. in Statistics — Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE) B.Sc. in Statistics — Federal University of Paraíba (UFPB) Research Agenda In my academic trajectory, I actively develop research in statistical learning, supervised classification, and unsupervised clustering/segmentation.

item.title: Course Materials & Teaching
item.description: Welcome to the Course Materials & Teaching page! Here you will find syllabus outlines, lecture notes, coding exercises, and interactive slides for courses I teach across undergraduate and graduate programs in Statistics and Data Science at the Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE). Undergraduate Courses Introduction to Data Science (Introdução à Ciência de Dados) Foundational course covering data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, visualization, and computational data science in R and Python.

item.title: Extras & Resources
item.description: Welcome to the Extras & Resources repository. Here you will find quick links to academic CV formats, open repositories, IDEs, and setup instructions. Academic Curriculum Vitae (CV) My CV is built using R Markdown and the pagedown package, adapted from Nicholas Strayer’s template: Interactive Online CV (pt-BR): https://jodavid.github.io/cv/ Downloadable PDF Version: jodavid_cv.pdf (Direct Download) Source Code Repository: https://github.com/jodavid/cv Scientific Computing & Tools Course Code Repository: Machine Learning and Statistical Learning notebooks — https://github.

item.title: Presentations & Talks
item.description: Welcome to my Presentations & Talks repository. Below are slides, interactive web presentations, and materials from keynote lectures, workshops, conference talks, and academic seminars delivered across statistics, machine learning, AI, and remote sensing. 2026 Matrix-Variate Probabilistic Models for Remote Sensing Data [Pt-BR] Presentation delivered at the 6th Brazilian Congress of Young Researchers in Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, and Statistics (VI CBJME). Collaboration with Nascimento, A. D. C., and Frery, A.
